location.basis: Centre of our z18 mosaic. We placed it from the published position (29 deg 28 min N, 74 deg 08 min E) and the imagery, which shows the fenced, eroded mound north-west of the modern village of Kalibangan; the mound spans about 74.127-74.133 E, 29.471-29.476 N.

main_system_reason: No system: we found no measurable Harappan line.
notes: The Esri imagery is a Vantor Vivid mosaic of 1 March 2026 with real detail to zoom 18 (0.52 m per pixel). The protected area holds one large, gullied mound and a wooded low area to its west. The excavations of 1961-69 are backfilled, and the mound surface shows erosion gullies, visitor paths and faint rectilinear marks that follow the outlines of the old excavation trenches. At full resolution and at 5x magnification none of these marks resolves into a wall face, street edge or drain that we could follow over 20 m, and the clearest straight features are the modern fence and field boundaries around the reserve. We therefore report Kalibangan as not measurable from this imagery; its layout has to come from the published plans.
